title: Uncle Logic Speed Run #1: Hot Streak
author: UncleLogic
rules:
Uncle Logic Speed Run #1: Hot Streak is a no-givens variant Sudoku using Thermometers and Kropki dots.

Sudoku:

Place the digits 1–9 in every row, column, and 3×3 box, with no repeats.

Thermometers:

Digits along each thermometer must strictly increase from the bulb toward the tip.

Kropki Dots:

Digits separated by a white dot are consecutive.

Digits separated by a black dot are in a 1:2 ratio.

Not all possible Kropki dots are necessarily given.

There are no given digits.

Speed Run:

This puzzle is designed to be solved quickly. If you'd like, post your solve time in the comments!

Play online:

Solve in SudokuPad

I hope you enjoy it!

More puzzles by me can be found at UncleLogic.com.
solutionCode: Enter the digits in Row 6 from left to right.
